title: Milestone Score Tax Causes Score Deduction on Pickup
explanation: At frame 363 (t=7.26s) and recurring at frames 1013, 1048, 1186, 1570, 1596, 2953, 3029, 3183, 3250, 3362, collecting coins or killing enemies when score >= 500 caused score to decrease by 10 points instead of increasing. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L40-L41 where bug_milestone_score_tax subtracts 10 points on subsequent pickups when score >= 500, violating the score monotonicity design contract.
